Firebase JavaScript SDK 12.19.0, the browser module files from the npm package "firebase" (npm pack firebase@12.19.0, 2026-11-05).
Only change: the absolute import of firebase-app.js from www.gstatic.com is pointed at ./firebase-app.js,
so the app needs no CDN. Licence: Apache License 2.0, stated in the header of each file (full text: https://www.apache.org/licenses/LICENSE-2.0).
